questions.text: The size of the data count register of a DMA controller is 16 bits.The processor needs to transfer a file of 29,154 kilobytes from disk to main memory.The memory is byte addressable. The minimum number of times the DMA control lerneeds to get the control of the systembus from the processor to transfer the file from the disk to main memory is ____.
questions.solution:
A 16-bit count register lets the DMA move at most [latex]2^{16}[/latex] bytes = 64 KB each time it takes the bus.

[latex]\lceil29154/64\rceil=\lceil455.5\rceil=456[/latex]

Answer: 456

questions.text: In X=(M+NxO)/(PxQ), how many one-address instructions are required to evaluate it?
questions.solution:
Evaluate the denominator first so that it can be used directly from memory:

LOAD P, MUL Q, STORE T, LOAD N, MUL O, ADD M, DIV T, STORE X

8 instructions

Answer: 8

questions.text: The minimum time delay between the initiation of two independent memory operations is called
questions.solution:
Memory cycle time is the minimum gap between the start of two successive memory operations. Access time is from request to data ready, which is shorter.

Answer: Cycle time

questions.text:
The contents of the flag register after execution of the following program by 8085 microprocessor will be

Program
SUB A
MVI B,(01)H
DCR B
HLT
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- SUB A: A = 0, CY = 0
- MVI B, 01: no flags change
- DCR B: 01 [latex]-[/latex] 1 = 00 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] S = 0, Z = 1, P = 1 (even parity), AC = 1 (done as 01 + FF, carry out of bit 3). CY is not affected and stays 0.

Flags S Z x AC x P x CY = 0 1 0 1 0 1 0 0 = 54H

Answer: [latex](54)_H[/latex]

questions.text:
A hard disk system has the following parameters :
Number of tracks =500
Number of sectors/track =100
Number of bytes /sector =500
Time taken by the head to move from one track to adjacent track =1 ms
Rotation speed =600 rpm.
What is the average time taken for transferring 250 bytes from the disk ?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Average seek: (500 [latex]-[/latex] 1)/2 = 249.5 tracks [latex]\times[/latex] 1 ms = 249.5 ms
- Rotation: 600 rpm [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 100 ms per rotation, so average latency = 50 ms
- Transfer: one sector (500 B) takes 100/100 = 1 ms, so 250 B takes 0.5 ms

Total = 249.5 + 50 + 0.5 = 300 ms

Answer: 300 ms
